project.name: MUMRO Academy
project.summary: Bilingual (EN/PL) open handbook at academy.mumro.io: lessons, interactive labs, playbooks and glossary, built as a static Astro site.

layout.purpose: EN/PL lessons, playbooks and glossary as typed data

rules: Every change in src/content/*.ts keeps EN and PL structurally identical; assertLocaleParity enforces this at build time.
Never weaken assertLocaleParity, scripts/verify-build.mjs or Playwright assertions to make a check pass; change them only as a separate, explained step.
Lessons state numbers and research claims only with a source, and describe agent-harness-kit only as its current code behaves.
